Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the products of the neutralization reaction between HCl and NaOH. It claimed the products were "NaCl and OH" (Option B), which is chemically impossible because the hydroxide ion (OH⁻) from the base reacts with the hydrogen ion (H⁺) from the acid to form water (H₂O), not remain as a separate product alongside the salt. The correct products are NaCl and H₂O (Option D). The error stems from a fundamental misunderstanding of acid-base neutralization principles and a failure to verify the chemical validity of the selected option before declaring the task complete.
